This sibling JSON exists because every thesis_v2 figure writes one, so the figure and the prose beside it can be diffed. What is recorded below is (a) the one symbolic quantity the figure sets, (b) the literal strings it prints, and (c) the measured geometry, which is the thing that actually changed in the rebuild.

This wording is inherited unchanged from v1 and was NOT altered here, because harmonising it would be a content edit outside the three layout changes commissioned. Flagged for a decision, not decided.
